value: 豪宅与产业升级·豪宅升级

【制作人意图】'从普通地产到顶级豪宅的资产跃迁'：用Before/After视觉对比+结果层强化证明经营深度；起点(一级豪宅/空地)→现金投入→完成态(豪宅/泳池/车队/安保)
【场景落地】左侧一级豪宅/产业→中央一叠现金投入并拉动升级条→右侧完成态豪宅(泳池/车队/安保明显增加)；同镜头角度Before/After；A版豪宅升级
美漫写实+明亮犯罪喜剧；施工光效/车队/人群强化；同镜头Before/After
豪宅建筑模型(一级/满级)；泳池/车队/安保NPC；施工光效/粒子；产业产出UI；image32/33/34

为GTS黑帮SLG游戏生成一张Google Play商店图（1080×1920竖屏），主题：豪宅与产业升级·豪宅升级。风格：美漫写实（类似《蝙蝠侠：阿卡姆》《看门狗》游戏美术）× 明亮犯罪喜剧 × 霓虹黑色城市氛围；暖金/橙红前景 vs 冷紫蓝夜晚背景、电影级布光、真实材质；绝不是Q版萌系、不是扁平卡通。暴力只暗示、不血腥。不用真实明星脸。不复制GTA/浴血黑帮的Logo、字体、服装。

[左侧] 一级豪宅/产业的初始状态。[中央] 一叠现金投入，拉动升级进度条。[右侧] 完成态豪宅：泳池、车队、安保人员明显增加，与左侧同镜头角度形成清晰的before/after对比。施工光效和粒子强化转变。同镜头before/after是本图核心。本版升级对象是豪宅。

[UI] 完整集成手游SLG商店截图UI：顶部资源条（粉钻+3K/银币+200K/金币+500K+/齿轮设置/信封邮件，黑底白字圆角芯片）；左上角圆形玩家头像（紫色描边）+昵称+粉色星星等级30+紫色拳头战斗力数字；右上角俯视城市小地图+城堡据点图标；左侧竖排按钮ACTIVITY/PASS/STARTER（红色通知点）；右侧RANKING/SHOP/OPSS/BAG；底部居中大字标题\"TURN CASH INTO POWER.\"（白色粗体无衬线全大写，深色底衬，占底部15-20%）。

Create a Google Play store featured image (1080x1920 vertical) for a mafia SLG mobile game called GTS. Theme: turn cash into power - mansion upgrade before/after. in the style of American comic realism with neon-noir crime city energy (like Batman: Arkham / Watch Dogs game art), bright crime-comedy mood, warm golden/orange/red foreground contrasting with cool purple-blue night background, cinematic lighting, realistic materials, NOT cute/chibi, NOT flat cartoon. Keep violence implied, not gory. No realistic celebrity faces. Do not copy GTA or Peaky Blinders logos, fonts, or exact costumes.

[LEFT] A level-1 mansion/property in its early state. [CENTER] A stack of cash is being poured in, pulling an upgrade progress bar. [RIGHT] The completed mansion: pool, car fleet, and security guards visibly added, same camera angle as the left for a clear before/after contrast. Construction light effects and particles emphasize the transformation. Same-lens before/after read is the core of this image. This version upgrades the mansion.

[UI] Standard mobile SLG store screenshot UI, fully integrated: top resource bar (pink diamond +3K, silver coin +200K, gold bar +500K+, gear settings, envelope mail, dark-bg white-text rounded chips); top-left circular player avatar with purple border, nickname, pink star level 30, purple fist power number; top-right top-down city minimap with castle base icon; left vertical buttons ACTIVITY / PASS / STARTER with red notification dots; right vertical buttons RANKING / SHOP / OPSS / BAG; bottom-center large title \"TURN CASH INTO POWER.\" in white bold sans-serif uppercase on a dark backdrop, occupying the bottom 15-20%.
